Directory Sync (SCIM) covers provisioning, but that is a different mechanism from just-in-time provisioning at login. Missing for 10: any evidence of domain verification for organizations, explicit just-in-time user provisioning on first SSO login, and direct documentation that each organization is bound to its own SSO connection.

Organizations can also carry custom metadata and be managed through the API, dashboard or MCP server. No evidence covers invitation flows, so that third element of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: any documented invitation flow, dedicated docs on the organization/membership model itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant modeling.
